raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-18 the source sends amount corrections as a repeated txn_id with a higher record_version. 27 txn_ids have two rows, and 25 of them have both rows POSTED, so they are duplicated in silver. The fix keeps only the latest version per txn_id, then filters to POSTED.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM latest WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
